name: flo2-calc
description: Exact math and logic for the decisions in a design: compose a computation graph of arithmetic, logic, comparisons, roots and logarithms, trigonometry and statistics with units checked, over single values or arrays (element-wise operations, sums and other reductions, statistics over data, the FFT), get every value exactly, correctly rounded or in float64 and labelled so, and keep a re-runnable computation record a decision can cite. Stands alone; no other server needed.
